definitions.explanation: A gaming term for completing a game or section as fast as possible using real time, including all loading times and pauses. Popular in the Japanese gaming community.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧RTA⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}している→挑戦する：21602_chousensuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm attempting a speedrun of this game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧RTA⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a video of the world record speedrun.

examples.japanese: RTA⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Speedrunning requires both practice and luck.

notes:
RTA (Real-Time Attack) is a speedrunning category that measures total time in real time.

RTA CATEGORIES:
- Any%: ⟦{最速|さいそく}→最速：13075_saisoku⟧⟦クリア→クリア：10825_kuria⟧ (fastest completion, any method)
- 100%: ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦クリア→クリア：10825_kuria⟧ (all items/objectives)
- Glitchless: ⟦バグ→バグ：06098_bagu⟧なし (no exploits)

RELATED WORDS:
- TAS (Tool-Assisted Speedrun): ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧⟦プレイ→プレイ：12840_purei⟧
- ⟦{走者|そうしゃ}→走者：21578_sousha⟧: speedrunner
- ⟦{通|とお}し→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦プレイ→プレイ：12840_purei⟧: full run (from start to end)
- ⟦タイム→タイム：23539_taimu⟧アタック: time attack

RTA differs from TAS (tool-assisted speedrun) in that RTA is performed by human players in real time without frame-by-frame manipulation.
